ideamine

An idea inbox for Claude Code: /idea saves ideas at zero tokens; Claude triages them and routes each to the cheapest model that can build it.

1 // Stand-in for the Claude Code CLI: returns a verdict for every idea in the prompt and records how
2 // it was called, so tests can check flags and environment without spending tokens.
3 import fs from 'node:fs';
4 
5 let input = '';
6 for await (const chunk of process.stdin) input += chunk;
7 
8 if (process.env.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG) {
9   const env = {};
10   for (const key of ['CLAUDECODE', 'CLAUDE_EFFORT', 'CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET', 'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL']) env[key] = process.env[key] ?? null;
11   fs.writeFileSync(process.env.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG, JSON.stringify({ args: process.argv.slice(2), env, input }));
12 }
13 
14 const ids = [...(input.split('Ideas to triage')[1] || '').matchAll(/^#(\d+)/gm)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
15 const verdicts = ids.map((id, i) => ({
16   id,
17   verdict: i === 2 ? 'skip' : 'do',
18   impact: 3,
19   size: 's',
20   model: i === 1 ? 'haiku' : 'sonnet',
21   title: `Idea ${id}`,
22   why: 'test',
23   brief: `Build ${id}.`,
24 }));
25 
26 process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({
27   type: 'result',
28   subtype: 'success',
29   is_error: false,
30   result: '',
31   structured_output: { verdicts },
32   total_cost_usd: 0.0012,
33   usage: { input_tokens: 321, output_tokens: 45 },
34 }));
